reason: The first month costs me nothing and I only pay if my boys actually use it, so there is no risk in letting the founder set it up. With my 30-odd technicians, ₹4,499 works out close to what the ₹99-per-head apps charge, and the AMC reminders alone could save me renewals I lose every year.
objection: Getting 7 out of 10 jobs through the app from 30-plus technicians is a big ask, and if only half use it I am back to WhatsApp. I also worry that after two years the price jumps and I am stuck because all my AMC records are in it.
would_change_my_mind: If the first month shows my technicians will not use it, or the reports come out wrong in Tamil and my coordinator has to fix them, I drop it.
